nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the cleanser controlling excess shine and reducing blackheads and clogged pores without over-drying their skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to very dry skin consistently report the cleanser does not strip or dehydrate their skin, and some say it even helps with dry patches.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin say it balances oily and dry areas without irritation, though one found it too abrasive and felt it did nothing for her skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some managing eczema or dermatitis, mostly report no irritation or flare-ups, though one felt it was a bit harsh on certain areas of her face.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing her skin as normal to dry says it helped with the occasional dry patch.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to late 60s describe smoother texture, more radiance, and gentle exfoliation that does not sacrifice hydration.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s and older report smoother, brighter-looking skin and no added dryness after adding the cleanser to their routine, though none describe a specific effect on fine lines or wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin repeatedly say the cleanser does not strip or dehydrate their skin, some noting relief for dry patches; one reviewer with combination skin, however, found it too abrasive and said it did nothing for her.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with combination skin reports no redness or flaking after use; another who says exfoliants typically make her face turn red chose to use this one at night as a precaution, without describing an actual reaction to it.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers managing eczema or dermatitis report no flare-ups after several weeks of use and describe the cleanser as gentle, though one notes needing to moisturize more when exfoliating.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say the cleanser does not cause breakouts and report fewer blackheads or brighter-looking blemishes; one reviewer, however, cautions against using it on active, inflamed acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe reduced shine and less excess oil after use, without the cleanser feeling drying.

aspects.libelle: Gel texture lathers into soft foam

extraits.texte: I have combo skin, not sensitive at all. I've used plenty of exfoliating products in the past, but this didn't match up to them. It felt too abrasive on my skin, and did not do anything for it. However, I have given it to others to try. I'm not sure of their skin condition but they have told me they liked it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This product is very moisturizing but because I have sensitive skin on my face in certain areas it did feel a bit harsh. But overall it's an okay product to try out!! Especially for combination skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I docked a star by virtue of it being a physical exfoliant; I have never loved the experience of grinding tiny bits into my face. That being said, this is the gentlest, least irritating physical exfoliant I have used by far. It smells nice and it doesn't HURT to use or feel like it's cutting up my face; there is still a grindy sensation but it's much more bearable than other physical exfoliants. I felt exceptionally fresh and clean after using it and it didn't break me out or irritate my skin after using it a few mornings in a row. I have very dry skin and my skin did not feel stripped or dehydrated after use. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been enjoying the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser for my 40+ skin. It gently exfoliates with fine bamboo beads while cleansing away impurities without leaving my skin feeling stripped. I especially love the addition of hyaluronic acid and aloe bioferment-my skin feels soft, refreshed, and noticeably smoother with a healthy glow after cleansing. A lovely option when mature skin needs gentle exfoliation without sacrificing hydration. ✨

I'm a product junkie, so when I first got the opportunity to test out the Clinique Moisture Surge Gentle Exfoliating Glow Face Cleanser, I was excited. I've used other scrubs in the past, but this one takes the cake. It's not too abrasive, and it doesn't scratch up your skin like shell scrubs can do. I've used this scrub daily for about a month now and definitely see a difference. For context, my face is usually dull, combination skin with some signs of aging (I'm newly 40), and large pores. Since using this scrub, I've noticed that not only has my skin texture improved, it also is brighter. After use, my skin doesn't feel tight, and I've noticed it has helped reduce the shiny forehead syndrome that I often end up with after a few hours. 10/10 would absolutely recommend! (Note: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.)

I absolutely love this exfoliating cleanser. It is moisturizing and does not strip the skin barrier like most exfoliating cleansers. There are plenty of beads in this cleanser so you do get a good exfoliation. It is actually great for sensitive skin. I have very sensitive skin and it is helping me clear it up. I been dealing with dermatitis and this has helped tremendously. It does give moisture back into the skin. Also it's gentle enough for everyday use. I would definitely recommend it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have combination skin and often have a hard time finding the perfect products, but this cleanser paired with my 10% niacinamide serum + Zinc made my skin glow, plump, and feel the right way. Not dry, not oily, even most of my blemishes have brightened up and I don't get as much blackheads anymore! This will forever be my cleanser as long as the formula stays this way. I love it so much!
